This is MLMM with one variable which has RS  

```{r}
# -----------------------
# Parameters 
H <- 5  # Number of sites
m_hosp <- sample(15:30, H, replace = TRUE)  # Number of patients per site
px <- 6  # Number of covariates
p_bin <- 3  # Number of binary covariates
p_cont <- px - p_bin  # Number of continuous covariates
py <- 3 # Number of outcomes (multivariate)

# Fixed effects
beta <- matrix(runif(px*py, 1, 5), nrow = px, ncol = py)

# Variance components
sigma_u <- 0.2  # Site-level RI sd
sigma_v_hosp <- runif(H, min = 0.5, max = 0.7)  # Patient RI sd by hospital

# --- NEW: patient-level random slope (per hospital), correlated with patient RI
rs_idx <- p_bin + 1                # which X column gets a random slope
sigma_rs_hosp <- runif(H, 0.25, 0.5)  # Patient RS sd by hospital
corr_ri_rs <- 0                  # Corr between patient RI and RS (same within each hospital)

# Exchangeable correlation structure for residuals
sigma_e <- 0.5
rho <- 0.5
rho_mat <- matrix(rho, nrow = py, ncol = py); diag(rho_mat) <- 1

# -----------------------
# Generate IDs
nn <- rep(m_hosp, times = 1)                 # patients per hospital
id.hosp <- rep(1:H, times = m_hosp)          # length = sum(nn); hospital per patient
id.pat <- sequence(nn)                        # patient index within hospital
n_visits <- sample(1:20, sum(nn), replace = TRUE)  # visits per patient

# Expand to visits
id.visit <- sequence(n_visits)
id.hosp.expanded <- rep(id.hosp, times = n_visits)
id.pat.expanded  <- rep(id.pat,  times = n_visits)

# -----------------------
# Random effects
# Site-level RI
u_h <- rnorm(H, mean = 0, sd = sigma_u)

# Patient-level (RI, RS) ~ N(0, Sigma_h) with hospital-specific sds and fixed corr
# Sigma_h = [[sigma_v_h^2, rho*sigma_v_h*sigma_rs_h],
#            [rho*sigma_v_h*sigma_rs_h, sigma_rs_h^2]]
b_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = sum(nn), ncol = 2)
for (p in seq_len(sum(nn))) {
  h <- id.hosp[p]
  S <- matrix(c(
    sigma_v_hosp[h]^2,                     
    corr_ri_rs*sigma_v_hosp[h]*sigma_rs_hosp[h],
    corr_ri_rs*sigma_v_hosp[h]*sigma_rs_hosp[h], sigma_rs_hosp[h]^2
  ), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
  b_mat[p, ] <- mvrnorm(1, mu = c(0, 0), Sigma = S)
}
b0_hi <- b_mat[, 1]  # patient RI
b1_hi <- b_mat[, 2]  # patient RS

# Expand site RI to visits (via patients)
u_h_patient  <- rep(u_h, times = m_hosp)             # length = sum(nn), aligned with patients
u_h_expanded <- rep(u_h_patient, times = n_visits)   # length = total rows

# Expand patient RI/RS to visits
b0_hi_expanded <- rep(b0_hi, times = n_visits)
b1_hi_expanded <- rep(b1_hi, times = n_visits)

# -----------------------
# Covariates
X_bin  <- matrix(rbinom(sum(n_visits) * p_bin, size = 1, prob = 0.3),
                 nrow = sum(n_visits), ncol = p_bin)
X_cont <- matrix(rnorm(sum(n_visits) * p_cont, mean = 0, sd = 1),
                 nrow = sum(n_visits), ncol = p_cont)
X_hij  <- cbind(X_bin, X_cont)

# -----------------------
# Multivariate errors (exchangeable across outcomes)
epsilon_hij <- mvrnorm(
  n = sum(n_visits),
  mu = rep(0, py),
  Sigma = diag(sigma_e, py) %*% rho_mat %*% diag(sigma_e, py)
)

# -----------------------
# Outcomes with site RI, patient RI, and patient RS on X[, rs_idx]
Y_hij <- matrix(0, nrow = sum(n_visits), ncol = py)
x_rs  <- X_hij[, rs_idx]  # covariate with random slope

for (k in 1:py) {
  # fixed + site RI + patient RI + patient RS * covariate + error
  Y_hij[, k] <- X_hij %*% beta[, k] + u_h_expanded + b0_hi_expanded +
                b1_hi_expanded * x_rs + epsilon_hij[, k]
}

# -----------------------
# Data table
three_lvl_dat <- data.table(
  site    = id.hosp.expanded,
  patient = id.pat.expanded,
  visit   = id.visit,
  X_hij, Y_hij
) |> data.frame()

setnames(
  three_lvl_dat,
  c("site", "patient", "visit", paste0("X", 1:px), paste0("Y", 1:py))
)

# (Optional) keep the random effects for diagnostics
# three_lvl_dat$b0_hi <- rep(b0_hi, times = n_visits)
# three_lvl_dat$b1_hi <- rep(b1_hi, times = n_visits)
# three_lvl_dat$u_h   <- u_h_expanded

# -----------------------
# Preprocessing and reordering
visit_count <- three_lvl_dat |>
  dplyr::group_by(site, patient) |>
  dplyr::summarise(total_visits = n(), .groups = "drop")

rearranged_data <- merge(three_lvl_dat, visit_count, by = c("site", "patient")) |>
  arrange(site, total_visits, patient) |>
  mutate(site = factor(site))
```


# PEAL 

$$
\begin{aligned} 
\tilde X_h^\top \tilde X_h &= (R_\rho^{-1/2}\otimes X_h)^\top\,(R_\rho^{-1/2}\otimes X_h) \\ 
&= (R_\rho^{-1/2})^\top R_\rho^{-1/2}\ \otimes\ X_h^\top X_h \\ 
&= R_\rho^{-1}\ \otimes\ S_{h,XX}. 
\end{aligned}
$$


```{r}
source("../PEAL-Multivariate/PEAL_Engine_Multi-RS.R")
# XYZ
Y <- as.matrix(rearranged_data[, paste0("Y", 1:py)])
X <- as.matrix(rearranged_data[, paste0("X", 1:px)])
X <- cbind(X)
x_rs_name <- paste0("X", rs_idx)

Z <- construct_Z_list(rearranged_data, x_rs_name)


id.site <- rearranged_data$site
```



```{r}
fit_mv_ind <- peal.fit.RS_mv(
  Y = Y, X = X, Z = Z, id.site = id.site,
  weights = NULL, reml = TRUE,
  corstr = "independence",       
  estimate_rho = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)


fit_mv <- peal.fit.RS_mv(
  Y = Y, X = X, Z = Z, id.site = id.site,
  weights = NULL, reml = TRUE,
  corstr = "exchangeable",        # or "independence"
  estimate_rho = TRUE, rho_init = 0.1,  # estimate residual correlation
  verbose = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
c(beta)
fit_mv_ind$b
fit_mv$b

fit_mv_ind$b.sd
fit_mv$b.sd
```

```{r}
# Correlation
rho
fit_mv_ind$rho
fit_mv$rho
```

```{r}
# Residual
sigma_e^2
fit_mv_ind$s2
fit_mv$s2
```

```{r}
diag(sigma_e, py) %*% rho_mat %*% diag(sigma_e, py)
fit_mv$Sigma_e
```


```{r}
# RE
c(sigma_u, sigma_v_hosp, sigma_rs_hosp)
sqrt(fit_mv_ind$theta * fit_mv_ind$s2)
sqrt(fit_mv$theta * fit_mv$s2)
```

```{r, eval = F}
bench::mark(
  peal.fit.RI_mv(
  Y = Y, X = X, Z = Z, id.site = id.site,
  weights = NULL, reml = T,
  corstr = "independence",       
  estimate_rho = F,
  verbose = T)
  )
bench::mark(
  peal.fit.RI_mv(
  Y = Y, X = X, Z = Z, id.site = id.site,
  weights = NULL, reml = T,
  corstr = "exchangeable",       
  estimate_rho = T,
  verbose = T)
  )
```
